create_CAIPDataset: create a CAIPDataset instance with a tokenizer and args to load CAIP format data
getitem_CAIPDataset: get a tokenized text and tree pair example by index from the CAIPDataset
add_hard_example_CAIPDataset: add a hard example to the CAIPDataset buffer for resampling during training
len_CAIPDataset: get the dataset length of a CAIPDataset instance for iteration or batching
contains_span_indices_CAIPDataset: check if a token index list contains valid span indices in the CAIPDataset
